title: FRZ-BND-05 PASS candidate label is not backed by a gate that tests construction/composition
impact: The only gate mapped to FRZ-BND-05 (EBH-6 BND bundle) asserts that intergrax/contracts does not import runtime; it does not test that cross-layer construction happens only through sanctioned composition. Remaining evidence is RAG composition (EBH-2G) and CE-01. A tracked HIGH tier-boundary residual (HIST-F-BND-03B, Tier-0 dynamic imports of Tier-3 manifest modules) is not reflected in the BND-05 row. Anyone using the VALID_SCOPED_PASS_CANDIDATE label to prioritise BND-05 for promotion would be misled about coverage.
recommendation: Downgrade BND-05 to QUALIFICATION_GAP or add a construction/composition-ownership gate (closed-world scan of cross-layer constructors) before the row enters the audit queue; cross-reference HIST-F-BND-03B in the row.

title: FRZ-PRD-07 PASS candidate cannot be confirmed: strict-path evidence partial and strict fixture defect persists at baseline
impact: PRD-07 (strict vs lab semantics separated) rests on D4 and P2-N02; the worker itself records the P2-C HTTP part as user-reported/partial log and P2-B not replayed at HEAD. HIST03-F-015 (HIGH) reports the strict GCA host cannot be built with both document_store and key_value_cache; the guard that raises the ValueError is still present at baseline. Whether PRD-07 evidence is reproducible at the baseline is therefore unknown (call chain not re-traced by EQO-A, no test run).
recommendation: Replay the D4/P2-N02 nodes at the pinned SHA and confirm whether F-015 blocks them before treating PRD-07 as a pass candidate.

title: FRZ-BND-01 downgrade is stale: the red EBH-4 gate was fixed by the P4 product batch the matrix itself pins
impact: The BND-01 row was downgraded from VALID_SCOPED_PASS_CANDIDATE because the EBH-4 nexus gate was red at pin ba07ebaa3 (offender intergrax/runtime/tools/tool_operation_recovery.py). The independent product audit reports that gate passing (12 passed) at 427646f41, which is the row's own p7_evidence_sha, and the file has no nexus reference at baseline. The downgrade reason is stale, so the row under-states BND-01 relative to sibling BND/CTR rows; the other F01 modules were not replayed by EQO-A.
recommendation: Re-run the P5 F01 selection at a pinned SHA and restore the candidate label if green; fold P4 audit results back into the matrix rows they affect.
